basis: Criterion-level assessment of the pinned Qt Widgets / GUI-QML source comparison, with the recorded recipient-note failure included. Implementation parity does not imply runtime acceptance. Missing screenshots, untested hardware and untested platforms do not by themselves reduce implementation parity. RPC capability counts where the Widgets baseline also permits RPC.
groupRule: Parity when every subfeature is at parity; not implemented when every subfeature is absent; partial parity for any other combination.
